sources.title: Myanmar eVisa Tourist Visa frontend
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Official Myanmar eVisa frontend is served over valid HTTPS on moip.gov.mm, last modified 13 August 2026. Its public JS configuration has an empty API base URL; direct unauthenticated MasterData nationality and passport routes return the application HTML shell, not a country result. Replayed 26 August 2026: HTTP 200 on the listed official HTTPS URL; no per-residual nationality result was exposed.

sources.title: Myanmar eVisa Frequently Asked Questions
sources.officialityEvidence: The live public FAQ JSON is served over valid HTTPS on the same MOIP eVisa host, last modified 20 May 2026. It says 100 nationalities are eligible but provides no list or per-nationality endpoint. Replayed 26 August 2026: HTTP 200 on the listed official HTTPS URL; no per-residual nationality result was exposed.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Nationals of 100 countries are eligible for a Tourist eVisa.

sources.title: Myanmar eVisa FAQ: issuance on arrival
sources.officialityEvidence: The current MOIP FAQ distinguishes emailed approval from the actual visa stamp and identifies the arrival counter as the issuance point for an eligible approved applicant. Replayed 26 August 2026: HTTP 200 on the listed official HTTPS URL; no per-residual nationality result was exposed.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Your visa will be issued and stamped inside your passport at the Myanmar Immigration Arrival counter.

sources.title: On-Arrival Visa Information
sources.officialityEvidence: The live page is served over valid HTTPS on the official mofa.gov.mm domain. Its direct tourist VOA list names China, Italy, Australia, Germany, India, Spain, Switzerland, Russia, then five additions effective 1 January 2020; none is in this residual. Replayed 26 August 2026: HTTP 200 on the listed official HTTPS URL; no per-residual nationality result was exposed.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Passport holder from the following countries are eligible to apply Visa On Arrival for Tourist Visa.

sources.title: List of Countries Having Bilateral Visa Exemption Agreements with Myanmar
sources.officialityEvidence: The live official PDF is dated as of 27 January 2026. Its ordinary-passport column positively records only named exemptions; it does not establish an advance-visa complement for other rows. Replayed 26 August 2026: HTTP 200 on the listed official HTTPS URL; no per-residual nationality result was exposed.
